utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, the latest I’ve got is Sunday at 10 in the community center lot, and I’m trying to keep things lined up with Faye’s 9:30 to 1:30 window too. If you’re thinking of joining, what timing works on your end?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can be there by 10, and I’m planning to start with the donated tools and pull aside anything missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam—10 works with what I’ve got, and having you start on the donated tools will really help us get organized fast. I’ll keep you posted if any logistics shift, but for now let’s plan on Sunday at 10 at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s shaping up nicely, I think—people keep adding to the pile, which is lovely. I still need to get a proper count together, but the turnout’s been better than I expected.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like folks are really showing up. Once you get a count, let me know if there’s anything specific still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I will—thank you. Off the top of my head, we’re alright for enthusiasm, but I still need to sort out the actual tools and what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that Rosa’s organizing it, and folks are saying Saturday morning, but I’m still not sure if it starts at nine or ten.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still good for Saturday 9:30 to 1:30, so either start time can work for me around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s helpful—if Rosa’s organizing it, I should check with her and pin down whether it’s nine or ten before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll still bring a little for the repair drive—it’s not much, but I want to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I got here late, Uli, but that really does help—thank you. Don’t stretch yourself too thin; we’re glad you’re pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Dane. Things are a bit tight right now, but I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, I’d stick with the community center lot and pencil in nine for now, but please check with Opal so we can confirm the start time cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm for sure whether it’s the community center lot or the garden lot, and who’s actually bringing the tools so we know what’s being stored there at nine?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d plan on the community center lot, not the garden lot, but I still want Opal to confirm it cleanly; I don’t have a firm tool list yet, so let’s check with her before we count on anything being stored there at nine.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there at 9 with the drill and ladders, and I’ll check in at the repair drive table right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll plan for 9 too and bring my toolkit, gloves, and a few extra cords.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Bo — I’ll see you at 9 and bring the drill and ladders over to the repair drive table when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quinn, it’s still looking like a 10-ish start this weekend, and we’re mostly sticking to safer small fixes for now while Cleo finishes the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—that helps a ton; I’ll keep spreading the word for a 10-ish start at the shed and let folks know we’re focusing on the safer small fixes for now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—that’s really helpful. If Cleo confirms the tool list or a firmer start time, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—Gus is bringing everything to the community center around 9 on Sunday, and I’ll line it up there when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve logged Gus arriving at the community center around 9 on Sunday, and I’ve got you lining everything up there when he gets in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, that’s the plan for Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m still open to helping, but I need the full tool list, who’s bringing what, and the storage spot confirmed before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia—that’s fair. I’m organizing it, and the latest update is Sunday at the community center; I’m still confirming the tool list, who’s bringing what, and the storage spot, and I’ll send you the full details as soon as they’re locked in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, Rosa—once you’ve locked down the tool list, who’s bringing what, and the storage spot, send it over and I’ll take another look.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: At the community center at nine, Noah—I’ve been repeating that to everyone so nobody misses the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—community center at nine. I keep losing track of it, so I’m glad you’re telling everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it, Noah—I’ll keep repeating community center at nine so everyone shows up in the right place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Cleo, can you check the sign-up count now so I can set the target for cords and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep—I’ll check the sign-up count now and get it back to you so we can set the target for extension cords and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—send me the number as soon as you have it so I can lock in the cords and gloves target.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I give Mina a number, can you confirm whether the sign-up count we’re using is still just the online form and not the paper list?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard anything saying that changed, so I’d still go with just the online form for now—but maybe note the paper list separately until Hana gets a firmer update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—then I’ll treat the online form as the official count for now and keep the paper list separate until we get a firmer update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Leo, we’re meeting at the community center at nine for the repair drive—I’ve been repeating it to everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—Gus is bringing everything to the repair drive table at 9, and I’ll line it up there when he gets in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Leo—I’ve been telling everyone it’s the community center at nine, and Gus will check in at the repair drive table when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s coming along pretty well, I think—we’ve already got the fence latch, Mrs. Alvarez’s porch step, and that busted bike tire on the list. I’m still nailing down the exact start time, though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds good—I'm a little turned around on the time too, but I’ve been telling folks the community shed this Saturday, and I should check with Quinn before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that’s probably smart—I keep mixing up nine, ten, and maybe even eight, so let’s stick with Saturday at the community shed until Quinn confirms the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—if it’s still Saturday around 9, I’ll bring basic tools and gloves unless Rosa says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Bo—I’m sorting the donated tools first and setting aside anything missing parts, and we’ll treat the time as tentative until Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—just ping me when Leo locks the time, and I’ll show up with tools and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, before I answer, can you confirm whether you want the headcount from just the online form or from the paper list too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Both, please—the online form and the paper list together. If you can check with Rosa so the total’s accurate before you give me a number, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll check with Rosa and make sure I’m combining the online form with the paper list before I give you a total.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that Rosa’s organizing it and it’s Saturday morning, but I’m still fuzzy on whether it starts at nine or ten—have you heard the latest from her?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Last I heard, it’s still around 10-ish, and Cleo said they’re mainly sticking to safer small fixes while she finishes the final list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks—I’d still love to hear straight from Rosa, but 10-ish for the Saturday repair drive sounds like the best word I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m jumping in late again, Opal, but the last I heard from Vik was the repair drive’s at the community center at nine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have it pinned to the community center lot, but Rosa’s latest was Sunday at 10, not nine. Can you check if Vik got a newer update?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late to this too, Opal, but I only remember Vik saying the community center at nine, so I’d better check with him in case that changed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on a few basics—extension cords and work gloves are top of my list, and I’m comparing with Jules tomorrow to catch anything else.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible; once you compare with Jules, let me know the final list, and I’ll plan around it after Opal confirms whether we start at nine or ten.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—once I compare notes with Jules tomorrow, I’ll send you the final list so you can plan around the start time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there by 9 with the drill and ladders, and I’m happy to jump on the safety fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus—thank you. We’re starting with space heaters, lamps, and the other safety fixes, and I’ll have the repair drive table ready when you get there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Mara—I’ll bring the drill and ladders to the table by 9 and start wherever the safety repairs need me most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there Sunday at the community center, Rosa, with a little to help. Thank you for understanding.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Uli—that’s a big help, truly. I’ll look for you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday with what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, how many people have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure on the exact count yet, Mina; I’ve mostly been waiting on a clear list of who’s bringing tools and where everything will be stored before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, I need the sign-up count first—can you check the latest list and tell me how many people are actually in so far?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Last I heard they’re still aiming for Saturday morning, though Marcy said it could slip a little, and people still seem ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that for sure, Tess, and that Gus is still bringing the tools to the repair drive table around 9?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can’t swear to it for sure yet, Kira—I’ve only heard they’re still aiming for Saturday morning, and I haven’t heard anything solid about Gus bringing the tools at 9.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but that timing sounds workable for me. If you lock it in around 10, I can swing by and help where there’s a gap.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds great, Ira—I’m still down for Saturday 9:30 to 1:30, so around 10 should fit nicely if Leo locks it in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—that should line up on my end too. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out, and if 10 gets confirmed I’ll head over when I’m done.
